tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search for European companies and other legal entities by name, country, status, or kind. Returns up to 25 entities by default.

country.description: ISO-2 country code: no, fi, se, dk, de, nl, pl, uk

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get the full record for an entity by Cardinal ID.

tools.name: lookup_by_registry
tools.description: Look up an entity by its native registry id (e.g. Norwegian organisation number, Finnish business id).

tools.name: get_entity_risk_summary
tools.description: AI-generated compliance risk briefing for an entity. Includes risk score, signals, and KYB recommendation.

tools.name: search_court_records
tools.description: Search bankruptcy filings, judgments, and enforcement actions across jurisdictions.

tools.name: search_officers
tools.description: Cross-entity search for officers (directors, owners, trustees).

tools.name: natural_language_query
tools.description: Ask any question about European entities in plain English. Cardinal translates to a structured query, runs it, and returns rows + a written summary. Examples: 'Norwegian construction companies in bankruptcy in last 3 months', 'companies whose director is on the EU sanctions list'.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: Run a Cardinal alpha backtest over historical entity signals. Returns equity curve, Sharpe, max drawdown, trade count. Useful for evaluating signal kinds like 'bankruptcy_distance', 'officer_churn_rate', or 'sanctions_proximity' before live use.

tools.name: get_trade_idea
tools.description: Fetch a single Cardinal trade idea by its idea_id. Returns the underlying signal, entity, conviction score, suggested holding period, and any linked court / officer / sanctions evidence.

tools.name: defense_brief_today
tools.description: Get today's daily defense intelligence brief — a signed Ed25519 bundle including FMS sale deltas, missile-test activity, sanctions-list changes, and CN/RU/IR signals. Returns brief metadata + content; full tarball is fetched separately.

tools.name: defense_brief_date
tools.description: Get the defense intelligence brief for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD). Same shape as defense_brief_today but historical. Briefs are cryptographically signed and offline-verifiable.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (must be in the past)

tools.name: ccsi_spot
tools.description: Get the current Cardinal Composite Shadow Index (CCSI) spot value — Cardinal's aggregate macro pressure index derived from insolvency / sanctions / supply-chain substrate. Returns the latest fixing plus delta vs prior trading day.

tools.name: ccsi_fixing
tools.description: Get the CCSI fixing (official close) for a specific date. Returns components by sub-index and the signed fixing receipt id.

tools.name: price_benchmark
tools.description: Get the current benchmark price for a SKU in a region. Includes median, p25, p75, sample size, and source mix (distinct vendors / receipts feeding the estimate).

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Get historical benchmark prices for a SKU in a region over a given period. Returns a daily time series with confidence bands.

tools.name: sauron_insight
tools.description: Get a one-shot Sauron insight for an entity — a compact, agent-readable summary of the most material risk / opportunity signals derived from all Cardinal substrates.

tools.name: sauron_dossier
tools.description: Get the full Sauron dossier for an entity — comprehensive walk across officers, court records, sanctions, defense, prices, and xrefs. Heavier than sauron_insight; use when an agent needs the complete picture.

tools.name: country_summary
tools.description: Get the country rollup for a jurisdiction — entity count, active-vs-dissolved mix, recent insolvency cadence, top sectors, and substrate coverage scores.

country_code.description: ISO-2 country code (no, fi, se, dk, de, nl, pl, uk, ...)

tools.name: person_dossier
tools.description: Get the full dossier for a natural person by Cardinal ID — all directorships, ownerships, court appearances, sanction matches, and cross-source xref links.
